comment: SITES.md step 2: the Hithermost cluster, three sites stacked up one pass and claimed by one module. Walked the whole way, not started by hand: onto Hithermost's door off the world map, up the village past the sign and the woman at the well, in at the chapel, Sir Dunstable, the Book - which is the save screen, and is the mechanic this site exists for - Brother Quillon, out through the porch, up to the Door into the Mountain, which refuses, and down the road back onto places.HITHERMOST_STEP. Then the other two world-map doors: the chapel's, which goes straight in, and the mountain's, which says no from the outside as well.
